name: list-item
title: List Item
description: One row of a list: `leadingSlot` (an avatar, a checkbox), a truncating `title` over a `description`, `meta` and `actionSlot` at the far end. With `onPress` the middle is one button and `leadingSlot` and `actionSlot` stay separate controls beside it, never nested in it. Built from `Item`'s parts at `size="sm"`.
